Therefore the prior large-file-body transport blocker for the training pool is resolved in this tested route, but the exact 10 taskDescription-overlap identities are not yet bindable to the 50 eval manifest rows from these two blobs alone because the join key used by the published overlap statement (taskDescription) is absent from the manifest.
No absence claim is made for an eval per-task/result artifact or deterministic game_idx-to-taskDescription mapping; those surfaces were not opened in this bounded slice.
